prerequisites.title: Verified Todoist account
prerequisites.detail: Check you have a verified Todoist user account before certification. Todoist may help with a Pro account if you need one for development.

prerequisites.title: Listing assets
prerequisites.detail: Prepare a marketing description, installation instructions, website and privacy policy links, a 250x250 JPG icon, 1600x1000 JPG screenshots and a demo video. All form fields must be in English.

prerequisites.title: HTTPS redirect URL
prerequisites.detail: Redirect URIs must use HTTPS, though localhost is allowed for testing.

steps.title: Create app in App Management Console
steps.detail: Log in and create the application, then add valid OAuth2 redirect URLs.
steps.done_when: You have a Client ID and Client Secret.

steps.title: Pick the minimum scopes
steps.detail: Choose the narrowest scope, such as task:add or data:read, rather than the default data:read_write.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config through Composio's API with your client ID and secret. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard into the Todoist app.

steps.title: Prepare listing text and assets
steps.detail: Draft the description with the not-affiliated disclaimer and an independence-style name, and check the image sizes.

steps.title: Record demo video and submit
steps.detail: Record the demo video and submit the certification form with the legal and business details.

steps.title: Wait for Todoist review feedback
steps.detail: Todoist aims to respond within ten business days and replies to emails within two.
steps.done_when: Integration is certified or feedback is received.

traps.title: Clients registered via dynamic client registration get a client
traps.detail: Clients registered via dynamic client registration get a client secret that does not expire.

traps.title: Todoist cannot be the primary app name
traps.detail: Use a name like 'x for Todoist' and state the app is not created by, affiliated with, or supported by Todoist.

traps.title: Token limit can suspend your app
traps.detail: An app that exceeds the maximum token limit, or is suspended for abuse, gets an invalid_application_status error. The limit value was not found.

traps.title: Meeting criteria does not guarantee certification
traps.detail: Todoist's listed criteria are only representative of what it checks.

traps.title: Restricted scopes are rejected
traps.detail: Scopes that are unknown or restricted to first-party use are rejected with invalid_scope.

traps.title: Multiple redirect URIs need redirect_uri
traps.detail: If your app has several redirect URIs, omitting redirect_uri causes an invalid_request error.

blockers.what_it_means: The app exceeded the maximum token limit or was suspended for abuse.
blockers.what_to_do: Contact Todoist; the limit value is not published in the evidence.

blockers.what_it_means: The redirect URI is not configured in the App Management Console.
blockers.what_to_do: Add the exact redirect URI from Composio to the app.
blockers.agent_can_help: Compare the configured and requested redirect URIs.
